bank.scaling: pooled fitting inputs and target deltas; shared by every mode
bank.residual_distribution: mode-specific independent density-calibration mean and OAS covariance
bank.likelihood_units: physical delta-state Gaussian density including log determinant

reference_metadata.mode_weights: uniform-prior softmax of 16-step MEAN log densities; tempered diagnostic weights, not sequential belief
reference_metadata.alternative: equal mixture of four known changed modes versus normal

limitations: Full-state physical templates and true labels are privileged diagnostics, not an online belief implementation.
Fresh frozen-policy trajectories from one source training seed do not reproduce prior updating-policy failures.
Known mild gravity/compound profiles; neither extreme-OOD performance nor closed-loop return confirmation.
